Question B-001-015-001.

Why the correct answer is right: Operating under your call sign keeps the operation within your qualifications, even if the person at the controls has additional qualifications.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Any privileges allowed by the additional qualifications": The additional operator's qualifications do not transfer to your call sign for this operation.
- sourceIndex 2: "All the emission privileges of the additional qualifications, but only the frequency privileges of your qualifications": Splitting emissions from frequency privileges is not the rule; the operation is limited by your qualifications as a whole.
- sourceIndex 3: "All the frequency privileges of the additional qualifications, but only the emission privileges of your qualifications": Borrowing only the visitor's frequency privileges still exceeds the certificate boundary attached to your station operation.
